Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: BD-C01 revision 2, Bastion class design study for a cyberpunk occult roguelike, transparent full-body character holding equipment.
Input image 1 is the edit target and approved comic-rendering quality reference. Keep the bold clean ink contours, flat cel shades, ivory/graphite palette, steel grey sword on image right and steel rectangular shield on image left. The shield is flat to camera centered on the left hand, hiding that hand and part of forearm. Sword grip and arm aligned. No additional weapons.
Change the BODY PROPORTIONS and the helmet/armor design for maximum presence when the human body is shrunk to 32 pixels tall. Compact powerful human proportions, about 4.5 head heights from crown to soles, LARGE helmet, broad torso and shoulders, short substantial legs, thick readable boots and gloves. Avoid miniature head, long skinny legs, slender ankles, realistic seven-head proportions, or overly cute baby/chibi.
Class identity: industrial heavy assault armor, chunky squared ivory shoulder blocks, broad reinforced chest slab, braced boots. Helmet should be a low broad industrial sealed helmet with a single LARGE dark horizontal rectangular visor and angular chin guard, very different from the current medieval T-shaped faceplate. No T visor, no ear cup discs, no medieval or licensed suit. Distinct broad rectangular silhouette.
Rendering: same polished 2D bande dessinée as target, strong DARK solid ink outlines intentionally much thicker than target (roughly 3% of body height so lines survive native 32px reduction), a few broad flat shade regions, no thin seams, no tiny rivets, no texture or gradients. Large bright ivory patches separate the limbs clearly. Adult serious cyberpunk agent, no text, no labels, no background, no shadow below feet. Full equipment remains visible and may extend above or sideways beyond body bounds; NEVER shrink the body to accommodate sword/shield. Full body standing in the same readable frontal three-quarter direction, feet both visible. Body centered and occupies most image height except the sword overflow. Genuine transparent alpha.
